# Test Enter submission through visible Account Hub states

browser_accountHub checks invalid Enter feedback, returns from found configuration to the initial form, then presses Enter to find settings again and continue into the password step. The password error case submits by Enter and waits for the header error class. Retain the visible-state and error checks when changing form submission. The component auto-form test also keeps untouched empty fields neutral until interaction. These are inspected test assertions, not tests executed here, and no full keyboard or screen-reader validation is claimed. These conclusions come from static source inspection. No runtime test or accessibility session was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Account Hub submit regression coverage.
